customers_say: Customers find the digital lock easy to use and appreciate its premium appearance and safety features. Moreover, the installation and service receive positive feedback, with one customer noting it works well on wooden doors. However, the value for money and reliability aspects receive mixed reviews.

reviews.author: Aashmit
reviews.title: Lock
reviews.body: RamAvtar Jangid has done a perfect job & Godrej lock is undoubtedly lock. Go for it

reviews.author: vaibhav pandey
reviews.title: Service
reviews.body: Great product with excellent quality. The service was exceptionally quick, and the technician was highly knowledgeable, patient, and explained everything in a clear and easy-to-understand manner. The entire experience was smooth, professional, and hassle-free. Highly recommended for both the product and the outstanding customer service.

reviews.author: Venu
reviews.title: Happy customer
reviews.body: I like it very much and service also very fast . Very happy

reviews.author: DEEPAK VEHAL
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Great experience with godrej and the installation process was very quick and easy. Technician was very good. Technician Name- Guddu

reviews.author: PSS
reviews.title: Un-trained technicians basically know only carpentry work only.
reviews.body: Technician could not configure WIfi with the digital lock。 He is not experienced。 also does not have time to configure He put the blame on internet provider and went off。 For such a expensive lock, the technicians should be properly trained not only carpentry work but also ensures proper software and complete configuration. Very disappointing. Options are available for Rs 10K onwards, but preferred Godrej for their service, and reputation。
